summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing completion of enrollment in a Phase 1 dose escalation study of IPH4502, a Nectin-4 antibody-drug conjugate. The filing is a routine business update regarding clinical trial progress: 76 patients recruited in France and the US, with preliminary data expected by year-end. No terms, prices, premiums, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics of a transaction are present. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is an ordinary progress report on a clinical-stage product, not a special situation.
